name: Omega1
description: Omega1 — Abel's own robot, a Freenove FNK0043 4WD Raspberry Pi car (ordinary wheels), skid-steer. Every MEASURE_ME value must come from a tape measure, calipers or a scale on the real robot before this file is renamed and validated.
length_m: MEASURE_ME — chassis plate length, not the 0.21 m vendor envelope
width_m: MEASURE_ME — chassis plate width, not the 0.15 m vendor envelope
height_m: MEASURE_ME — floor to top of the tallest fixed part (vendor envelope says 0.125 m)
ground_clearance_m: MEASURE_ME — floor to the lowest point of the chassis plate
mass_kg: MEASURE_ME — whole robot on a kitchen scale, batteries in

component_mass_kg._note: Optional. Weigh parts only if you take them off anyway; otherwise delete this block.

motor.voltage_v: LOOK_UP — the yellow gearmotor's rated voltage from its label or the kit datasheet; leave the spec unfinished rather than guess
motor.stall_torque_nm: LOOK_UP or null if no datasheet value exists

battery.capacity_mah: READ_OFF — printed mAh on your 18650 cells

_provenance.drivetrain: DOCUMENTED — Freenove ordinary-wheel code turns with opposing left/right commands (four-wheel skid-steer); see RobotForge docs/freenove-evidence.md
_provenance.battery.voltage_v: DOCUMENTED — kit takes two 3.7 V 18650 cells in series (Freenove FNK0043 listing); 7.4 V nominal
_provenance.sensors: DOCUMENTED — kit ships an HC-SR04 ultrasonic module and a camera
_provenance.everything_marked_MEASURE_ME: MEASURED on the real robot by Abel — record the date when you fill it in
